(2) Montage of travel elements including an airport control tower under a cyan filter, Korean Air cargo containers, and a graphic of an airplane flying over the sky. (3) A young woman with dark hair and bangs smiles warmly in a selfie-style shot within a brightly lit airport terminal. (4) The woman and the man are seen standing on a busy street in South Korea, with an ABC Mart store visible behind them. (5) Transition to a large artificial wave pool facility called WavePark, showing a surfer riding a large, blue mechanical wave. (6) The man is shown practicing surfing on a blue board, while the woman is also seen in a separate shot riding a wave with a focused expression. (7) Wide shots of the facility layout: lounge chairs under umbrellas, a children's pool with colorful inflatables, and a deep diving pool with clear blue water. (8) A training session is depicted where a man in a white t-shirt points at a laptop screen displaying surfing analysis to another person. (9) The woman waves happily to the camera while standing by the edge of the wave pool, wearing a floral surfing suit and a black hat.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 1 male partner, and at least 10 other surfers, coaches, and staff members visible in various scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with black hair, bangs, and fair skin, wearing various athletic surfing outfits and a black sun hat. A man with short black/grey hair wearing casual t-shirts and surfing rash guards.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Scenes shift between a home interior, airport terminals, busy Korean urban streets, and a massive outdoor artificial surfing park (WavePark) with modern hotel-like buildings in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced female narration begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone over an upbeat EDM background music track at 124 BPM. Clean studio environment with minimal noise floor. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition to the airport scene, while the narrator's speed increases to match the montage. (3) Continuous splashing sounds of water and percussive impacts of surfboards hitting waves are layered into the mix. The narration maintains a friendly, storytelling quality. (4) Laughter and collective cheering SFX are intermittently used to highlight moments of success in the surfing pool. The music's beat remains a driving force in the audio profile. (5) The narration concludes with a warm, invitational tone as the BGM volume dips slightly before a final hard cut, coinciding with the end of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Surprise -> Discovery -> Evidence -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog to introduce 'WavePark' in Korea as a premier surfing destination. It utilizes a narrative hook about a 'boring' trip to Korea that turns into a high-intensity surfing training experience, aiming to attract travelers and surfing enthusiasts to the facility and the 'SurfCheck Taiwan' training group.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention and visual display of the brand logo, location name, and service offerings (surfing training).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines high-arousal narration with fast-paced visual editing of athletic activity to create a persuasive travel recommendation. The use of split-screens and high text density is characteristic of social-media marketing trends.
